Container.Name: wilson
Container.Overview:
A kanban board that runs its own cards: each card moves through stages of AI agents that plan, build and test it, and merges when it passes.
Everything is in this one container: the board, the daemon behind it and the API, on one port. Pick the tag that matches what your server already runs:
ghcr.io/maroonedsoftware/wilson:full brings PostgreSQL and a nightly backup. Nothing else needed. ghcr.io/maroonedsoftware/wilson:slim is Wilson alone. Point it at your own PostgreSQL 17.
Everything it keeps lives under Data, except the clones of your projects, under Projects.
First run: open the WebUI and create your account. The database schema is applied automatically. Then sign the engine in: save a token on the board's Settings page, or use the Engine token field below, or sign in from this container's console with claude and then /login.
Model-written code runs inside this container until you place worktree stages on a worker. Do that before running real cards: see PROJECT.md, Workers.
Container.Requires: An x86-64 server, and a git clone of each project Wilson manages (or a Project repository below). On the slim tag, a PostgreSQL 17 database that already exists.
Container.DefaultTagDescription: Brings its own database and backup. Nothing else needed.

Branch.TagDescription: No database. Fill in the database fields with your own PostgreSQL 17.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: The board and the API, on this one port. Workers connect here too.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Everything Wilson keeps: on the full tag its database and nightly backups, plus the session and encryption keys, worktrees and the Claude login. Back this up. Use the cache pool rather than /mnt/user, whose share layer is slow for PostgreSQL and for git's many small files.

Config.Name: Projects
Config.Description: The folder holding the clones of every project Wilson manages, each in a folder named after it. Wilson merges into these, so they must be writable by the user below.

Config.Name: Public address
Config.Description: The address you type into a browser to reach the board, all of it: scheme, host and port, with nothing after the port, such as http://192.168.1.10:13101. Passkeys are held to it, and they work only on https://. Sign-in with a password works without it.

Config.Name: Project name
Config.Description: The first project, and the name of its folder under Projects.

Config.Name: Project repository
Config.Description: Optional. Where to clone the first project from on first boot, when its folder under Projects does not exist. Leave empty if you put a clone there yourself. Wilson never pushes, so a read-only credential in the URL is enough for a private repository.

Config.Name: Engine token
Config.Description: What planning sessions, and any stage placed local, sign in with. Make one with claude setup-token. A token saved on the board's Settings page replaces this one, and changing it there needs no restart. Leave empty to use that, or to sign in from this container's console instead: run claude, then /login.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: An IANA zone name such as America/New_York. The nightly backup runs at 03:00 in this zone.

Config.Name: Database host
Config.Description: Slim tag only: your PostgreSQL 17 server. Leave every database field empty on the full tag, which runs its own.

Config.Name: Database name
Config.Description: Must already exist. Wilson creates its own schema inside it, not the database itself.

Config.Name: Database user
Config.Description: Owns the schema: Wilson applies its migrations as this user at every start. Avoid naming it wilson: a role named after the schema can break the first migration.

Config.Name: User ID
Config.Description: Who Wilson runs as. Unraid's nobody by default.

Config.Name: Worker engine token
Config.Description: What an engine on an SSH host signs in with. Workers bring their own, so this is unused unless you register SSH hosts, which this image cannot reach yet: it has no ssh client.

Config.Name: Notification webhook
Config.Description: Optional. Where to post when the machine stops and needs a person.

Config.Name: Notification links
Config.Description: The public address above, so a notification can link to its card.

Config.Name: Start work automatically
Config.Description: Let the daemon pick up cards itself rather than waiting for them to be started.

Config.Name: GitHub token
Config.Description: Optional. Used instead of the GitHub App (set up in Wilson's Settings) to import issues from the repository below.

Config.Name: GitHub repository
Config.Description: Optional. The repository to import issues from, as owner/name.
